text:
Frequently
 
Asked
 
Questions
 
(FAQs)
 
General
 
Information
 
 
Q:
 
Where
 
is
 
the
 
main
 
campus
 
located?
 
 
A:
 
The
 
main
 
campus
 
is
 
located
 
at
 
123
 
University
 
Drive,
 
Anytown,
 
USA.
 
Additional
 
satellite
 
campuses
 
and
 
research
 
facilities
 
are
 
located
 
in
 
surrounding
 
areas.
 
Q:
 
What
 
are
 
the
 
library
 
hours?
 
 
A:
 
The
 
main
 
library
 
is
 
open
 
24/7
 
during
 
the
 
academic
 
semester,
 
except
 
for
 
major
 
holidays.
 
During
 
br

eak
 
periods,
 
hours
 
are
 
reduced.
 
Please
 
check
 
the
 
university's
 
official
 
library
 
website
 
for
 
the
 
most
 
up-to-date
 
schedule.
 
Q:
 
How
 
do
 
I
 
access
 
the
 
campus
 
Wi-Fi
 
network?
 
 
A:
 
You
 
can
 
connect
 
to
 
the
 
"Uni-Secure"
 
network
 
using
 
your
 
student
 
ID
 
and
 
password.
 
If
 
you
 
encounter
 
any
 
issues,
 
please
 
visit
 
the
 
IT
 
Help
 
Desk
 
located
 
in
 
the
 
Technology
 
Building.
 
 
Using
 
Campus
 
Facilities
 
 
Q:
 
How

can
 
I
 
reserve
 
a
 
study
 
room
 
in
 
the
 
library?
 
 
A:
 
Study
 
rooms
 
can
 
be
 
reserved
 
online
 
through
 
the
 
library's
 
official
 
booking
 
portal.
 
Reservations
 
are
 
available
 
for
 
up
 
to
 
four
 
hours
 
at
 
a
 
time
 
and
 
can
 
be
 
made
 
up
 
to
 
one
 
week
 
in
 
advance.
 
Q:
 
What
 
are
 
the
 
hours
 
for
 
the
 
campus
 
gym?
 
 
A:
 
The
 
campus
 
fitness
 
center
 
is
 
open
 
from
 
6:00
 
AM
 
to
 
10:00
 
PM
 
on
 
weekdays
 
and
 
8:00
 
A

M
 
to
 
8:00
 
PM
 
on
 
weekends.
 
Students
 
must
 
present
 
a
 
valid
 
student
 
ID
 
for
 
entry.
 
Q:
 
Is
 
there
 
a
 
lost
 
and
 
found?
 
 
A:
 
Yes,
 
the
 
lost
 
and
 
found
 
office
 
is
 
located
 
in
 
the
 
Student
 
Services
 
Center
 
on
 
the
 
first
 
floor.
 
Please
 
bring
 
any
 
found
 
items
 
there,
 
and
 
if
 
you
 
have
 
lost
 
something,
 
you
 
can
 
check
 
with
 
them
 
during
 
business
 
hours.
 
 
Student
 
Services
 
&
 
Support
 
 
Q:
 
How
 
do
 
I

contact
 
academic
 
advising?
 
 
A:
 
Academic
 
advisors
 
are
 
available
 
via
 
email,
 
phone,
 
or
 
by
 
appointment
 
in
 
the
 
Student
 
Services
 
Office.
 
You
 
can
 
also
 
book
 
an
 
appointment
 
through
 
the
 
student
 
portal.
 
Q:
 
Where
 
can
 
I
 
get
 
mental
 
health
 
support?
 
 
A:
 
The
 
campus
 
counseling
 
center
 
provides
 
free
 
and
 
confidential
 
mental
 
health
 
support
 
for
 
students.
 
Walk-ins
 
are
 
welcome,
 
and
 
appointments
 
can
 
also

be
 
scheduled
 
online.
 
Q:
 
How
 
do
 
I
 
report
 
a
 
maintenance
 
issue
 
on
 
campus?
 
 
A:
 
Maintenance
 
issues
 
can
 
be
 
reported
 
through
 
the
 
campus
 
facilities
 
request
 
portal
 
or
 
by
 
calling
 
the
 
Facilities
 
Management
 
Office.
 
Q:
 
How
 
can
 
I
 
access
 
career
 
services?
 
 
A:
 
Career
 
services
 
offer
 
resume
 
reviews,
 
mock
 
interviews,
 
and
 
job/internship
 
postings.
 
Appointments
 
can
 
be
 
scheduled
 
online
 
or
 
by
 
visiting
 
th

e
 
Career
 
Center.
 
 
Academic
 
Resources
 
 
Q:
 
How
 
can
 
I
 
access
 
online
 
course
 
materials?
 
 
A:
 
Course
 
materials
 
are
 
available
 
through
 
the
 
university’s
 
learning
 
management
 
system
 
(LMS).
 
Log
 
in
 
with
 
your
 
student
 
credentials
 
to
 
view
 
lecture
 
notes,
 
assignments,
 
and
 
readings.
 
Q:
 
Where
 
can
 
I
 
find
 
tutoring
 
services?
 
 
A:
 
The
 
tutoring
 
center
 
provides
 
free
 
peer
 
and
 
professional
 
tutoring
 
in
 
many
 
su

bjects.
 
Sessions
 
can
 
be
 
booked
 
online
 
or
 
in
 
person.
 
Q:
 
How
 
do
 
I
 
check
 
my
 
grades?
 
 
A:
 
Grades
 
are
 
accessible
 
through
 
the
 
student
 
portal.
 
Log
 
in,
 
navigate
 
to
 
the
 
“Grades”
 
section,
 
and
 
select
 
the
 
relevant
 
semester
 
or
 
course.
 
 
Campus
 
Safety
 
&
 
Transportation
 
 
Q:
 
Is
 
there
 
campus
 
shuttle
 
service?
 
 
A:
 
Yes,
 
the
 
campus
 
operates
 
free
 
shuttle
 
buses
 
connecting
 
main
 
buildings,
 
dorms,
 
and

parking
 
lots.
 
Schedules
 
are
 
available
 
on
 
the
 
campus
 
transportation
 
website.
 
Q:
 
How
 
do
 
I
 
contact
 
campus
 
security?
 
 
A:
 
Campus
 
security
 
can
 
be
 
reached
 
24/7
 
by
 
calling
 
the
 
emergency
 
number
 
posted
 
across
 
campus
 
or
 
via
 
the
 
security
 
app.
 
Q:
 
Where
 
can
 
I
 
park
 
on
 
campus?
 
 
A:
 
Student
 
parking
 
is
 
available
 
in
 
designated
 
lots
 
with
 
a
 
valid
 
parking
 
permit.
 
Daily
 
and
 
semester
 
passes
 
can

be
 
purchased
 
through
 
the
 
campus
 
parking
 
office.
